# Editor Requirements Quality Checklist: Particle Universe — Phase 04 Scene editor and persistence

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the A04-P04 requirements: completeness, privacy, architecture ownership, iOS lifecycle,
testability, performance and release constraints.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Evaluated 2026-11-13 by the lead under the owner's standing delegation. Two items failed first (CHK008, CHK012); the
specification was corrected.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all saved fields of a scene listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-A04-402]
- [x] CHK002 Are save, open, rename and delete all specified, with relaunch persistence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-A04-401, 405]
- [x] CHK003 Is every phase gate of the manual mapped to a requirement? [Traceability, Spec §Traceability]
- [x] CHK004 Are out-of-scope items (import/export, presets, limit and time scale editing, dragging) explicit? [Completeness, Spec §Input, Clarifications]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the open sequence defined action by action with value counts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-A04-404, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK006 Is the name-clash rule unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK007 Are scene bounds for moving given numerically? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications (±500 via the force world extent)]

## Architecture Ownership and Lifecycle

- [x] CHK008 Is the fate of a half-completed open across termination specified? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases] — failed first: unstated; corrected: a pending open is never in the saved session state.
- [x] CHK009 Is storage confined to the experience's own area with its limits? [Ownership, Spec §FR-A04-401, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Is "no VisualCore change, no standalone work" stated? [Ownership, Spec §FR-A04-442, Input]
- [x] CHK011 Is atomic saving required on failure and interruption? [Lifecycle, Spec §FR-A04-414, Edge Cases]

## Accessibility, Privacy, Performance, Release

- [x] CHK012 Are accessibility requirements given for all new controls (library and move)? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-A04-405, 421] — failed first: only move had them; corrected for the library.
- [x] CHK013 Are network, sharing and third-party code excluded? [Privacy, Spec §FR-A04-441]
- [x] CHK014 Are test durations and simulation step counts bounded? [Performance, Spec §SC-A04-405, 406]
- [x] CHK015 Are device-only timings separated? [Release, Spec §Input]
- [x] CHK016 Is the replay determinism of opening measurable? [Testability, Spec §SC-A04-402]
- [x] CHK017 Are the bad-file kinds enumerated with expected outcomes? [Testability, Spec §US2, SC-A04-403]
